keywords: Criminal appeal – Heroin possession – 2.22 grams of diacetyl-morphine – Life imprisonment – Police detection based on information – Production chain – Inward journey of productions – Missing witness in chain – Seals – Government Analyst receipt – Alterations in receipt – Requirement to establish continuity and integrity of productions – Prosecution failing to establish inward journey to required standard – Conviction and sentence set aside – Accused acquitted and discharged – Appeal allowed.
